title: Time-bounded dedup tables for store-and-forward
description: Dedup tables for custody/DTN messages use absolute expiry keyed by message ID. Each entry expires at exactly the message's absolute TTL timestamp, then is garbage-collected. Provides deterministic memory budget. Spec: 06-security.md §15.3. All three impls. Python: message dedup dict with expiry. Rust: HashMap<MsgId, Instant> with periodic GC. C/Zephyr: fixed-size dedup array with expiry field.
